Lessons: What Is Prophecy?; Prophets and Their Times; Prophecies About Christ; Prophecy and Israel; The Day of the Lord; Revelation and Symbols; Living Hopefully in Light of Prophecy
Description: Prophecy can feel puzzling, but it was given to give God's people hope, not fear. This course teaches you to read prophetic books in context, trace promises fulfilled in Christ, and handle future-focused passages with humility and care. You will leave steadier and more hope-filled.
KeyTopics: Prophecy; Second Coming; Hope; Kingdom of God
